events.title: This year's FA Charity Shield is played at Wembley Stadium between league champions 리즈 유나이티드 and FA Cup holders 리버풀, both sides having appointed new managers for the first time in over a decade. The match ends in a 1–1 draw and 리버풀 win 6–5 on penalties, but it is marred by the dismissal of Leeds captain 빌리 브렘너 and 리버풀 striker 케빈 키건 .

The First Division season begins. Clough's first League match in charge of Leeds ends in a 3–0 defeat to 스토크 시티 . 칼라일 유나이티드 , in the First Division for the first time in their history, win 2–0 at 첼시 , and 맨체스터 시티 beat 웨스트햄 유나이티드 4–0. 맨체스터 유나이티드 play their first game outside the top flight since 1938, beating Orient 2–0 at Brisbane Road in the opening Second Division fixture. Football hooliganism was rife at the Orient match, with reports of clashes between United supporters and police, damaged Underground trains and fighting in the ground.

칼라일 유나이티드 move to the top of the league after winning their first three games in the First Division. In the Second Division, Old Trafford hosts its first Second Division game in 36 years as 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 밀월 4–0, with Gerry Daly scoring a hat-trick and Stuart Pearson scoring the other goal.

Following a poor start to the season and a 2–1 defeat by 맨체스터 시티 at White Hart Lane , longtime 토트넘 홋스퍼 manager Bill Nicholson resigns, citing burnout and the growing rift between him and younger players.

At the end of August, 리버풀 have gained the lead of the First Division under new manager 밥 페이즐리 , one point ahead of 입스위치 타운 , 에버턴 and 맨체스터 시티, whose 2–1 defeat of 리즈 유나이티드 leaves the champions just one point off the bottom.
